selection_metadata.provider_regression_guard: Each provider validation normalized MAE may worsen no more than 2% versus seasonal naive; select smallest qualified provider-balanced normalized MAE
selection_metadata.expert_routing_policy: Real-only phase-relative seasonal and raw harmonic residual experts; compare full already-observed 12-month revenue targets at up to three historical origins with at least 12 prior months; validation selects gain margin, no business cohort/provider labels used
selection_metadata.validation_target: Provider-specific geographic and terminal-time validation; Uzbekistan January-December 2025 is legacy development validation
selection_metadata.test_protocol: Fresh Eurostat six-country and whole-provider ONS audits, plus new engineering seed cohort, are constructed explicitly only after model freeze. Previous ABS/Canada, Uzbekistan and original synthetic test outcomes are consumed legacy regression benchmarks.
selection_metadata.selection_metric: Provider-balanced macro per-history-normalized validation MAE; training loss weight equal by provider; no final test outcomes used

abs.grouping: Provider-prefixed state/province; all industry series from one geography stay together. Sector records are dependent aggregate series, not independent firms.
abs.split_algorithm: SHA256('international-region-v1:' + provider + ':' + geography), sorted; floor(0.6*n) train, half remaining validation/test
abs.quality_policy: Reject an entire case if any required history/target month is missing, suppressed, unreliable, nonfinite or negative. Published zero sales remain actual zeros; all-zero history is excluded.
abs.test_policy: Terminal test labels are imported but must not be read for training or validation selection; build test cases only after final model freeze.

selection_metadata.temporal_scope: Holdouts are provider-local terminal years; Uzbekistan training through December 2025 overlaps some Australian/Canadian holdout dates. No absolute year, provider identity or cross-country shock covariates are features; this is not a globally chronological unseen-future test.
selection_metadata.limitations: Original retail turnover and service value are aggregate revenue proxies, not independent firm cash receipts. Native currency units remain separate and only dimensionless errors are pooled. Survey revisions, correlated economic shocks, Uzbekistan short post-methodology histories, and cross-country aggregate-to-borrower transfer limit claims. No real costs, defaults or repayments are supplied.
selection_metadata.selected_for_serving_by: Joint validation only: real candidate must improve provider-balanced normalized MAE at least 5% versus seasonal and each provider may regress at most 2%; then select net pooled MAE with macro/cohort guards using synthetic validation, without fitting real estimator to synthetic targets

short_history_policy: The same observed final targets are reused with only 3/6/12 historical months supplied. This is a stress slice, not more independent real observations, and does not choose or qualify the frozen candidate.

predetermined_acceptance.scope: Engineering forecast acceptance on new-provider actual revenue; not bank repayment/default validation

source_selection_policy: Whole-US Census MRTS was inaccessible without an API key; FRED workaround terms disallowed ML use. These sources were excluded before reading audit observations. The wholly unseen UK ONS source substituted solely for access/licensing; no source was selected on model errors.
limitations: Original aggregate nominal turnover/value indices are observed real revenues normalized to each publisher's base year, not borrower bank receipts or monetary values. Raw index points cannot be pooled across provider bases. Whole-country clusters retain within-country sector and economic-shock dependence. Seven intended audit countries provide limited descriptive uncertainty; current revision vintages are not an unrevised historical backtest. Dates are provider-local, since older-country training observations may follow an audit date. No real expense, repayment, capacity or default labels are present.
freshness_policy: No fitting/selection occurs here. Previously examined ABS/Canada terminal periods and old synthetic cohorts are legacy regression benchmarks. This audit is consumed once its results inform later model revisions; repeated frozen runs reproduce the same audit rather than creating independent fresh evidence.
